findings.statement: CPU processor work causes three large GPU-quiet gaps in IO; P0 removes these main-thread gaps by preparing on a CPU worker, not by removing processor computation.
Main-thread batch construction includes vision; its wall reduction must not be described as pure processor speed or halved GPU vision compute.
Backwards and 10-step proposal remain major bottlenecks; profiler timing does not demonstrate a proposal speedup.
NCCL kernel activity, runtime synchronization and nonzero/index/cast operators remain visible; cumulative inclusive operator times are hotspots rather than additive wall partitions.
Final active optimizer stage contains trace-export delay; exclude nominal update25009 from steady-update comparisons.
Process costs from PROCESS_EXIT and controller are 1.409784 GPUh total. TRAINING_COMPLETE GPU_hours includes inherited origin training and must not be attributed to these two profiles.

method.raw_trace_location: training-vlawm-zt4; raw traces remain private and were parsed in place
method.events: Complete traceEvents streaming JSON parse; SHA256 same pass; only public scalar event metadata summarized
method.GPU: Union of all kernel/memcpy/memset intervals on all captured streams clipped to ProfilerStep#6/#7/#8 CPU marker bounds; NCCL/non-NCCL/copy and overlap unions separate
method.CPU: Inclusive host wall scopes and per-Python-thread unions; CPU worker perf_counter rows independent of Kineto timestamps
method.launch_association: CUDA runtime and driver correlations mapped to enclosing same-OS-thread CPU labels. Complete event correlations do not imply complete CPU range ownership: backward workers run on other threads.
method.quantiles: Eight-rank window summaries are descriptive; original stage medians use rank-max per update over25011..25032; extended CPU max-of-rank nonactive medians has different bounds

limits: All label ranges inclusive; nested labels must not be summed.
GPU busy is union of captured GPU activities on all recorded streams, not SM occupancy.
NCCL duration can include waiting; NCCL_without_compute is not pure network overhead.
Runtime sync wall overlaps kernels/host scopes; do not add it to GPU time.
CPU rows use perf_counter; do not directly join absolute timestamps to Kineto.
Python thread IDs in CPU rows differ from OS TIDs in Kineto.
CPU row step hints are not exact prefetched input/update identities.
ProfilerStep boundaries differ from native update boundaries; final export can pollute stage timing.
Same-thread launch correlation is a subset: main-thread backward range does not own autograd-worker launches by thread; never use its correlated subset as total backward GPU cost.
Only three CUDA-active profiler steps per rank; profiled runs include instrumentation and cannot replace the preregistered benchmark.
No raw private images, tensors or traces persisted in this report.
CurrentBatchCollator preprocessing, pinning and other worker operations outside these labels are not fully covered.
Profiler with_stack=False has no new Python leaf-stack proof.
No current optimization acceptance, numerical acceptance, throughput claim or source change follows from this report.
